column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way I Wouldn't Help My Little Sister
Do I seriously have to do it?
You haven't been very cooperative since the beginning.
Of course. After all, I'm not troubled by it at all.
Even if you're not troubled, I am.
Huh? You being troubled has nothing to do with me.
I don't need any memories about having otaku hobbies.
...Ah, is that so.
H-Hold on. What's with that attitude of yours? Aren't you the one that isn't motivated?
...No, it's because you're just not willing to do it... So I don't know what to do.
I-I didn't say I'm not doing it.
As usual, I don't understand her at all. Which is it, then?
Come to think of it... this thing about memory loss, you actually fabricated all of it, right?
Yes, I'm sure that's it!
The problem is that all of it is true!
Guh... It feels that I'll start to think the same if you keep saying that...
*gasp*?! Could this be brainwashing?!
That's not it!
N-No...
Ah! You just stuttered! Why were you stuttering at that moment?
Isn't it about time you stop this?
I was just carefully choosing my words and yet you're reacting like this?! It's all real!
I'm not going to believe your words, no matter what you say.
Then why are you asking me?!
Hey, don't you feel terrible having some of your memories missing?
Well, I do feel that way a little.
However, I don't have any regrets if it's otaku memories.
Hey Kirino. Are you... seriously saying that?
I'm seriously serious, super-serious.
W-What's with the serious look...? Uwah, don't get all teary-eyed!
Geez. Listen, memories are important to building your character...
Don't lecture me with words you randomly memorized from watching TV.
...Anyway. Isn't giving up your memories the same as giving up part of your life?
Huh? Aren't you exaggerating too much?
Hey, just five minutes will do. If you don't like it, you can stop right away. So please chat with the two of them.
Hmph... If I say I don't want to?
What are you saying? Hurry up and sit in front of the computer.
W-What's that supposed to be, an order?
I will do anything for the sake of recovering your memories.
A-Anything, you say...
Tch, you've got some nerve even though you're a pervert.
...If you do that, I'll give up.
I'll admit everything up until now was my delusion.
Telling our parents, handing me over to the police, do whatever you want... But, the fact that lost your memories is the truth.
...Tch... Trying to fool me again...
...But, to think you would say that much.
Exaggerated, you say... It's something important to you...
I'm tired of listening to your lectures. Okay, you're dismissed～
...Kirino.
You're annoying!
I beg you! Kirino!
...*gulp*
Ah geez... I get it!
